Packing your entire Apple setup for travel usually means bringing along a pile of cables and socket adapters. The RORRY Flow power bank is designed to tackle this problem by putting everything you need into one compact battery. It comes with built-in wall prongs, an integrated USB-C cable, and a dedicated magnetic charger for Apple Watch. It is exactly the accessory I like most when travelling, because whether you're on the road or charging overnight, it handles everything.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers rounds up the latest and most exciting MagSafe and wireless charging products to help you get the most out of your wireless-charging-capable Apple devices.

Built for travel

The RORRY Flow power bank has foldable wall prongs built into the back. You don't need to bring an extra wall charger to charge the battery — just plug it straight into a hotel or holiday rental socket. It also comes with a built-in USB-C cable (I genuinely love this design!), so you don't even need to bring a cable to charge your iPhone, iPad, Kindle, Switch and other devices.

Although I usually focus mainly on MagSafe for iPhone here, this power bank specially includes a dedicated 5W magnetic charger for Apple Watch. When the watch is running low on battery, just place your Apple Watch on it and it charges instantly — incredibly convenient. It holds the watch securely while charging, so you don't even need to bring the official charger on the go.

This power bank has a capacity of 10,000 mAh, enough to keep your iPhone and Apple Watch going through a full day of activities. For me, the most practical feature is the 40W output via USB-C. In an emergency, even with the screen off, this wattage is enough to top up a MacBook Air.

RORRY Flow power bank summary

If you want to streamline your luggage for your Apple gear, the RORRY Flow power bank is a solid choice. It combines a wall plug, an Apple Watch charger and a USB-C cable into one, with a minimalist design that fits easily into a handbag or trouser pocket.

You can buy the RORRY Flow portable charger directly from RORRY or on Amazon.
